operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: F25 proved PostgreSQL Team Chat owner transfer semantics but actual server-bound p_actor provenance had not been tested against caller-supplied actor/instance IDs. Audit finds Team Chat API and two parallel server action paths use getAdminRequestUser() -> Supabase auth.getUser(), current scoped webshop, Pro teamChat plan gate and office.internal_chat capability; none currently accepts actor ID from untrusted payload. Add a dynamic mocked-handler adversarial regression that verifies an authenticated actor and server scope override forged actorId/instanceId fields, that missing authentication, Pro plan, active store context and chat permission block service_role RPC execution, and that malformed body and unverified RPC response do not claim success. Add source binding checks for BOTH server action owner-transfer/Team Chat paths plus explicit truth boundary note. Do not modify production auth logic without an actual defect, and do not claim native Supabase JWT cryptographic integration from mocked auth.
observableOutcomes: Dynamic direct POST handler proof: despite forged actorId/userId/instanceId in caller JSON, RPC p_actor equals server getAdminRequestUser user.id and p_instance_id equals server scoped instance.
Unauthenticated request, non-Pro plan, missing current store context, denied office.internal_chat permission, invalid request body must never invoke privileged service_role RPC.
Post RPC result mismatches requested thread/message reject success, RPC error is fail closed; keep valid authorized request accepted.

Source-level server action regressions assert both /admin/kommunikacio/chat and /admin/kommunikacio/iroda owner/Team Chat entry points bind actor/instance via getAdminRequestUser, requireCurrentStoreContext, requirePlanFeature(teamChat) and hasStoreCapability rather than client-submitted IDs.
Dated evidence note documents accepted server provenance, remaining native Supabase Auth/JWT/session and service-role p_actor spoof threat from any different privileged caller; no fake DONE.
No product runtime, auth helpers, canonical SQL, entitlements, billing or hosted DB changes; existing full source regression/TypeScript and Control Plane gates PASS.
unresolvedRisks: Mocked getAdminRequestUser does not cryptographically verify auth.getUser session; native Supabase JWT authentication proof remains required.
Source-based server action regression can miss runtime nuance; future request mocks or integration E2E required.
Existing getAdminRequestUser platform-role exceptions and session-store context may need native multi-tenant session integration, not addressed here.
Service_role can invoke SQL with any p_actor outside audited routes; forbid nontrusted callers and complete provider runtime/trace proof before release.
